content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on item:list, the scroll region labelled \"Item 190\" is long (page extent at least 8762 px) and has no in-list search or filter, so users scroll it back and forth with the pointer held at about (1275, 400) and no clicks until they reach a target row, as the repeated scroll_y reversals (for example 1800, 3600, 2950, 5150, 4250, 6850, 6050, 7850) in each session show.", "fix": "Fix: On the item:list screen, add a search/filter input above the scrollable list container (the element labelled \"Item 190\" and its sibling rows) that narrows rows by item name or code, so users can reach a row without scrolling more than about 12 screens.", "cited_event_ids": ["54", "56", "58", "59", "61", "63", "65", "66", "57:61", "60:67", "64:73", "67:79", "447", "449", "451", "453", "455", "457", "458", "460", "450:134", "452:139", "454:142", "456:146", "459", "446", "448", "450", "452", "454", "456"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The purpose of the scrolling (searching for a row) is not visible in the events; it is inferred from the reversals and the lack of clicks.", "The scroll_y values appear to be cumulative positions; direction is inferred from the reversal count in the insight, not directly from the events.", "Whether a search or filter already exists elsewhere on item:list is not shown in the windows.", "The pointer position is sampled at about 2 Hz, so pointer events may not show every pointer move.", "Console errors (ids 12, 87, 405, 403, 481, 482) and overlay events (33:w25 to 40:x35 and similar) occur before the scroll bursts and are not shown to be linked to the scrolling; they were not used as the cause.", "No abandonment is recorded, so whether the scrolling delays or blocks the task is not established beyond the 8.3 s median loss in the insight."]}
